about: T3.11's vectors: the reference's PredictiveQuery constructor on each S0 query text and on blank texts (reference), and Python's binding's answers to each S0 case's validate_query and to the test-only fail operation for every contract error code (binding). java/src/test/java/com/nvidia/sdm/ holds the Java host to them.

INTERNAL_ERROR.template: the core failed; this is a defect, not a problem with the request

INVALID_CONFIGURATION.template: the configuration of this call is not one the core accepts

INVALID_MESSAGE.template: the host sent a message the core cannot read

INVALID_REQUEST.template: a relationship given names a table or column the schema does not hold

INVALID_RESPONSE.template: the model endpoint answered with something the core cannot read

INVALID_SCHEMA.template: {reserved[0]} uses a name this client needs for the request it builds, so it cannot also be a column of the data. Rename it, for instance to {renamed[0]!r}.

MISSING_EXTRA.template: an optional dependency this call needs is not installed

PROVIDER_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.template: the data source answered with columns other than the ones asked for

REPLY_MISSING.template: the host went on before answering every request

RUN_BUSY.template: the run was already in a call; a run takes one call at a time

RUN_POISONED.template: the run failed earlier and can no longer be used

SESSIONS_UNSUPPORTED.template: the model endpoint does not support sessions

TRANSPORT_ERROR.template: the transport to the model endpoint failed: the endpoint could not be reached, or its answer could not be read

UNKNOWN_MODEL.template: the model named does not exist

UNKNOWN_REPLY.template: the host answered a request the core did not make

UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST.template: the in-memory fallback of this data source cannot count the rows of a table with no column

UNSUPPORTED_TYPE.template: column {column!r} has the Arrow type {arrow_type}, which the core does not take

VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.template: lag_timesteps reaches further back than a time can be held (before 1677); ask for fewer steps

WRONG_REPLY.template: the host answered a request with the wrong kind of reply
